title: zkFold x Defy: Cross-border payment infra using ZK tech

ms.promise:
・Develop a detailed work plan.
・Finalize KYC data format
・ZK pipeline able to read KYC data for ZK operations
ms.criteria:
・Finalize the concept for minting KYC tokens with hashed data.
・Ensure initial code is open source and available on GitHub.
ms.report:
Hello Milestone reviewers and voters. 
We completed the first Milestone of this proposal, all Milestone outcomes have been successfully deployed.
1. KYCData type is integrated into zkFold Symbolic framework. 
It is the main data type that will be used in descriptions of inter-banking requirements in this project. Now, we can create arbitrary statements about such data structures and verify them using ZKPs. 
See the link below: 
・https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-base/blob/main/symbolicapps/src/ZkFold/Symbolic/Apps/KYC.hs 

As a part of this output, we added support for JSON serialization/deserialization for zkFold Symbolic versions of bytestrings and unsigned integers, as well as for this new KYCData type. 
2. We have completed the Plutus smart contract that will be used to mint a “KYC token” that proves the completion of a particular KYC verification procedure. See plonkVerifierCompiled here: 
・https://github.com/zkFold/zkfoldcardano/blob/main/src/ZkFold/Cardano/UPLC.hs 
・https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-cardano/blob/main/src/ZkFold/Cardano/UPLC/PlonkVerifier.hs 

All code related to the smart contract has been thoroughly tested and benchmarked. For details, see:
・https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-base/blob/main/symbolicbase/test/Tests/NonInteractiveProof.hs 
・https://github.com/zkFold/zkfoldcardano/blob/main/test/Tests/Compatibility.hs 
・https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-cardano/blob/main/benchs/bench-cpumem/README.md

ms.promise: ・Create and validate Zero Knowledge (ZK) circuits based on general banking requirements.
ms.criteria:
・Finalize the design for ZK circuits to meet basic banking needs.
・Publish updated open-source code on GitHub.
ms.report:
Hello Catalyst Milestone reviewers.
We are glad to report on the successful completion on the second proposal Milestone.
The deliverables had been stated as:
・Finalize the design for ZK circuits to meet basic banking needs.
・Publish updated open-source code on GitHub.

And here it is:
The finalised ZK circuits to meet basic banking needs:
・https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-base/blob/main/symbolic-apps/src/ZkFold/Symbolic/Apps/KYC.hs 

And as stated, the work is licenced under a MIT licence which you can find at
・https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-base/blob/main/LICENSE

We are already in full progress to work on the next Milestones

ms.promise: Developing a proof-generator software (backend). This software will use Zero Knowledge circuits to build ZK proofs to prove user data without disclosing it.
ms.criteria:
"Complete the proof generator software for basic transaction validation.
Update the GitHub repository with the new software code."
ms.report:
We have completed the proof generator software for basic transaction validation and prepared a video illustrating the working code:
・https://github.com/zkFold/zk-kyc
・https://youtu.be/38LoSyBlnfc

ms.promise: Developing a Proof verifier software (backend). The verifier will be able to verify the generated proof, allowing institutions or banks to verify information without having access to the data.
ms.criteria:
Complete the proof verifier software to validate proofs generated by the proof generator.
Update the GitHub repository with the verifier software code.
ms.report:
We have completed the proof verifier software to validate proofs generated by the proof generator:
・Public link to the GitHub repository with the proof verifier code: https://github.com/zkFold/zk-kyc/tree/diS3e/fast-setup
・A video that illustrates the working code: https://youtu.be/ahcs0yxL1co
